transcript: A broken heart is not a failure, it is a signal. My friend, when the heart breaks, it is not because you love too much. It is because love touched something deep inside you that was never meant to stay closed. Do not rush to fix the pain. Pain that is rushed becomes heavier. Pain that is allowed begins to soften. First, stop asking why it happened. The mind asks questions the heart cannot answer. Instead, ask, what is this teaching me about myself? Second, return to the body. Place a hand on your chest. Breathe slowly. The heart heals through presence, not distraction. Scrolling, numbing, replacing. These delay the lesson. Third, release the illusion. You are not missing the person. You are missing the version of yourself that existed when you felt seen. That version is not gone. It is waiting for you to come back home. And finally, understand this. A broken heart does not mean you were weak. It means you were open. And openness is strength. One day, without effort, you will notice the ache is quieter. The breath is deeper. The heart feels lighter. Not because you forgot, but because you grew. If this spoke to you, stay close. Follow this path. And when you are ready, I will guide you gently through healing, step by step.
